<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Why Amazon Sellers Need an ITIN</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">Non-US citizen Amazon sellers who earn income from Amazon.com are required to report that income to the IRS. Amazon collects tax information from all sellers and may withhold 30% of earnings if proper documentation is not provided.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">The Amazon Tax Interview</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">When you register as an Amazon seller, you complete a tax interview. Without an SSN or ITIN, Amazon classifies you as a non-resident and applies default withholding.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">How an ITIN Helps</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">With an ITIN, you can:</p>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Submit Form W-8BEN to Amazon</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Claim tax treaty benefits</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Reduce or eliminate 30% withholding</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">File accurate US tax returns</li>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Step-by-Step Setup</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">1. Apply for your ITIN</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">2. Receive your ITIN assignment letter</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">3. Complete Amazon's tax interview with your ITIN</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">4. Submit Form W-8BEN</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">5. Start selling with proper tax status</p>
